input.content:
"""Compute count, mean, and median of numbers in data.txt (one per line)."""

with open("data.txt") as f:
    nums = [float(line) for line in f if line.strip()]

count = len(nums)
mean = sum(nums) / count
s = sorted(nums)
mid = count // 2
if count % 2:
    med = s[mid]
else:
    med = (s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2

with open("stats.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(f"count: {count}\n")
    f.write(f"mean: {mean}\n")
    f.write(f"median: {med}\n")
